verdict.rationale: Segment documents official source libraries for C#, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin (Android) and Swift, along with an analytics.track code sample and a Spec that applies "across all of Segment's libraries and APIs." The Public API reference also includes an "Install and use an SDK" section next to a downloadable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference docs (installation, versioning, maintenance), the language coverage of the Public API SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
